segments.text: 22 They ſhall driue thee from men, & thy dwellyng place ſhalbe with the beaſtes of the field. They ſhall make thee to eate graſſe as the oxen, and they ſhall wet thee with the dew of heauē, and ſeuen tymes ſhall paſſe ouer thee till thou know that the moſt hye beareth rule ouer the kyngdome of men.
